_comment: Brand-specific JSON-LD field preferences. The skill reads this file (when present) to decide which OPTIONAL fields to always emit or always omit. Required fields per references/recipes/json-ld-schemas.md cannot be overridden here.

_format.true: Always include this field if any value is available
_format.false: Always omit this field, even when the recipe recommends it
_format._omit: Field is not in this preferences file → use the recipe's default behavior

Product._note_for_user: Set sku/mpn to true if your brand has stable internal identifiers and wants them in JSON-LD. Set weight to false if your products vary too much for a single value.

FAQPage._comment: FAQPage JSON-LD has no optional brand-preference fields — recipe rules govern entirely. This block exists for forward-compatibility only.

Review._note_for_user: Set publisher to true to always include the brand as Review.publisher (helps cross-domain attribution).

Organization._comment: Organization-level JSON-LD is generated by /aeko-fix-technical, not /aeko-update-pdp. Set those preferences in that skill's references/examples/.
